title: fix(cli): os dev -a and os start --artifact serve the named artifact beside a cwd objectstack.config.ts — one artifact precedence for start, dev and the serve child
body:
Fixes #21501

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The ruling on the card is one precedence, written once: explicit flag > env (`OS_ARTIFACT_URL` / `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH`) > `dist/objectstack.json` > a cwd `objectstack.config.ts`. This PR does that in three parts.

- **The one resolver lives in `packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-precedence.ts`.**
  - `resolveArtifactBootSource()` holds the whole ladder: `--artifact` > `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` > `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` > `CWD/dist/objectstack.json` > `HOME/dist/objectstack.json` (`os start` only) > unresolved, which is the cwd config. `os start` and `os dev` both resolve through it.
  - `cwdConfigJoinsBoot()` answers the last rung: does the cwd config take part in this boot? The supervisors' `Config:` row and the `serve` child both read that one predicate.
  - `start.ts` drops its private `resolveArtifactSource` and its inline `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` handling. `dev.ts` drops its inline ladder, which had no `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` rung.
  - A structural pin refuses any read of `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` or `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` in `start.ts` or `dev.ts`, so a second copy of the order cannot grow back.
- **The `serve` child boots the supervisor's answer beside a config** (`serve.ts`).
  - Before, the child read `OS_INTERNAL_ARTIFACT_PATH` only when the cwd held no config. With a config present, the config boot ran instead, and its standalone stack re-derived the artifact from `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH`, falling back to `CWD/dist/objectstack.json`. The channel was never read.
  - Now the cwd config joins a supervised boot only when the supervisor's answer IS that config's own compiled output, `CONFIGDIR/dist/objectstack.json`. Any other answer boots alone, through the same artifact path a no-config directory takes. When the config does join, the config boot is handed the answer explicitly.
- **`os dev` flag over env** (`internal-artifact-channel.ts`). A `resolved` channel decision now removes `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` from the child env. Before, `start` did this inline and `dev` did not, so the reference won over `dev -a`. Without a flag, `dev` now treats a reference the way `start` does: it hands no channel down, prints a redacted `Artifact: ... (OS_ARTIFACT_URL)` row, and does not compile, watch or run the staleness check.

What does not change:

- A bare `os dev`, a bare `os start` in a project, and the documented `os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json` all name the config's own compiled output, so the config still joins on those paths. The showcase is a host config, and it still boots itself.
- A direct `os serve` is untouched, since no supervisor channel is involved.
- `packages/runtime`'s own fallback ladder (`resolveDefaultArtifactPath`, the standalone stack's path input) is not edited. Every supervised boot now hands it an explicit path.

## Measured at the public door

Two artifacts differ in one served value, the label of object `fx_widget`. The label was read back through `GET /api/v1/meta/object/fx_widget`, booted through the built entry `bin/run.js`.

| boot | before (base `550f4cc2fd`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| leg 1: `os dev -a ALPHA`, beside a config whose `dist/` holds BRAVO | Widget BRAVO | Widget ALPHA |
| leg 2: `os start --artifact ALPHA`, same directory | Widget BRAVO | Widget ALPHA |
| leg 2: `os start --artifact ALPHA`, config but no `dist/` | Widget CONFIG | Widget ALPHA |
| leg 2 control: `os start --artifact ALPHA`, no config | Widget ALPHA | Widget ALPHA |
| `os start --artifact ALPHA`, beside a host config (plugin instance in `plugins`) | Widget CONFIG | Widget ALPHA |
| `OS_ARTIFACT_URL=file://.../BRAVO.json os dev -a ALPHA` | Widget BRAVO | Widget ALPHA |
| `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH=ALPHA os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json` (dist = BRAVO) | Widget ALPHA | Widget BRAVO |
| `os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json` beside its config (documented path) | Widget BRAVO | Widget BRAVO |
| bare `os dev` beside a config (dist = BRAVO) | not measured | Widget BRAVO, `Config:` row, config loaded |

**`Artifact:` banner (A4).** Before the fix, the supervisor printed `Artifact:` from its own resolution before spawning. The child then printed `Loading objectstack.config.ts...` and a ready-banner `Config: objectstack.config.ts`, so one screen named two sources. After the fix, the child boots exactly the supervisor's answer, so the supervisor's row names what loads. Beside a config it no longer loads, the child says `objectstack.config.ts is not loaded — the artifact resolved for this boot outranks it`, where it used to say `No objectstack.config.ts found`. The supervisors print `Config:` only when `cwdConfigJoinsBoot` says the config takes part.

**Env leg (A5).** `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` already outranked a cwd config, so a config never overrode it. Measured: `OS_ARTIFACT_URL=ALPHA os start` beside a config served ALPHA. `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` beside a plain config served its artifact before too, because the standalone stack read the variable. But the config still composed around it, and the env-path artifact lost to a host config. Under the one rule, both now boot the artifact alone. Two flag-over-env violations were in scope and are now pinned: the `os dev` reference case and the twin-plus-`OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` case.

**Raise rule.** No deploy was measured serving a different stack this way. The shipped runtime image (`docker/Dockerfile`: `WORKDIR /srv/app`, `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` preset, `CMD os start`) and the scaffolded `Dockerfile` copy only the artifact into `/srv/app`, with no config beside it. That layout does not reach the defect.

## Pins

- `packages/cli/test/artifact-flag-precedence.integration.test.ts` (integration tier) runs 8 cases over the source entry. All boots happen in `beforeAll`, and each `it` reads what was recorded.
  - leg 1, leg 2 with and without `dist/`, and the leg 2 no-config control;
  - a host config beside a named artifact. This is observed through the boot's plugin roster, because the source entry runs `NODE_ENV=development`, where the dev metadata door serves ALPHA even with the config loaded;
  - the roster marker's positive control: a host config with its own `dist/`;
  - `dev -a` under `OS_ARTIFACT_URL`;
  - the documented path under an exported `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH`.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/artifact-child-env.pin.test.ts` is extended:
  - the ladder pins now drive `resolveArtifactBootSource`, with the URL rung and the home rung added;
  - `cwdConfigJoinsBoot` and `isConfigCompiledArtifact` cases;
  - the channel removes an outranked `OS_ARTIFACT_URL`;
  - a structural AST pin that `start.ts` and `dev.ts` read neither artifact variable, plus a detector self-check.

## Reverse verification

Each mutation was committed-tree ablated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with literal anchors. The subject runs from `src/` through `bin/run-dev.js`, so no `dist/` leg is involved.

| ablation | predicted red | observed |
|---|---|---|
| A: the whole serve fix (`configJoins` ignores the channel AND the config boot is not handed the answer) | leg 1, leg 2, leg 2 no-dist, host config, documented path | exactly those 5 red: BRAVO, BRAVO, CONFIG, marker present, ALPHA. Control, host positive control and flag-over-env stayed green. |
| A1: only `configJoins` ignores the channel | host config | 1 red, 7 green |
| A2: only the config boot is not handed the answer | documented path under `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` | 1 red (ALPHA), 7 green |
| B: the channel keeps `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` on a resolved decision | flag over env (integration) and the channel unit pin | 2 red (BRAVO), 37 green |

Every run ended with `ok restored: blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Verification (final commit `f5c0a890b7`, which is `main` at `1ac7308d7a` merged in)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: 251 files, 3678 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` passed, including `check:test-typecheck: OK` with the debt ledger unchanged.
- Integration: `artifact-flag-precedence.integration.test.ts` and `dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`, 16 of 16 passed.
- Before the merge, at `a2e8c44655`: `package-install-local-boot-steps.integration.test.ts` and `dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts` passed 15 of 15, and the nightly `start-signal-forwarding.e2e.test.ts` and `artifact-pinned-boot.e2e.test.ts` passed 11 of 11.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 67 families at `f5c0a890b7`. All 67 ran with exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), and were re-run green after a full `turbo run build`. `--ran` reconciliation: 67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, with the zero derived from recorded exit codes.
- `pnpm lint`: a proven narrowing, not the repo-wide run.
  - ① The population comes from `eslint.config.mjs`'s own globs: `**/*.{ts,...}` plus the `packages/cli/src/**` and `packages/**` objects. None of the 7 changed `.ts` files is ignored, since the JSON output carries no "File ignored" message.
  - ② `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 7 files reports 7 results, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - ③ Untouched files are unaffected. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, as the config's own header states), and it reads only two baseline JSON files at load, neither of them touched. So this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- **Host config on its own twin path (open question, measured).** A bare `os start` beside a host config whose `dist/` holds a different stack prints `Artifact: dist/objectstack.json` and serves the host module (Widget CONFIG). That is the same before and after this PR. Taken literally, the ruling's "dist > config" would boot `dist/` alone there. But a host config's code plugins do not survive compile, so the showcase would lose its connectors under `os dev` and `os start`. This PR keeps the config booting itself on that path, and the question goes back to the seat.
- `os dev` with `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` naming a non-default path still compiles the cwd config into that path and watches it, which is pre-existing. The child now boots that artifact alone, per env > config, so a host config compiled that way no longer composes its plugins.
- The `os dev` options table in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` lists `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` as the `-a` env equivalent. `dev` now also outranks `OS_ARTIFACT_URL` with the flag. The `os start` resolution line there already states the full order. Docs were not edited, as they are outside the card's file surface.
- The branch's merge commit `f5c0a890b7` carries no trailer pair. The other commits carry the model-free pair.
